description: This file defines a generic Graph class in Java, including methods for managing nodes and edges, and performing topological sorting with cycle detection.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A generic directed graph implementation supporting node and edge management, and topological sorting.

classes.name: Graph.Edge
classes.description: Inner class representing an edge in the graph with source and destination nodes.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Adds a node to the graph.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.description: Adds an edge to the graph.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a set of all nodes in the graph.

methods.name: getEdges
methods.description: Returns a set of all edges in the graph.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node matching the given element if it exists.

methods.name: getEdgesEndingWith
methods.description: Returns a set of edges ending with the specified node.

methods.name: topologicalSort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort on the graph, detecting cycles and throwing an exception if one exists.
